info.title: Exotic Stamp API
info.description: OpenAPI specification for Exotic Stamp backend services. Use this document for contract-first integration and manual API testing.

tags.name: Collection Runtime
tags.description: Canonical MVP collection APIs at /api/v1/collection (collect, stamp book, my stamps)

tags.name: Admin Station Scan Keys
tags.description: Production NFC/QR scan key lifecycle. Multiple ACTIVE NFC keys per station are allowed (e.g. multiple gates). payloadToWrite is returned only once at creation; mobile should write it as an NDEF URI record.

put.summary: Update current user profile (self-service fields only)

post.summary: Redeem voucher reward (disabled in MVP — returns 410)
Resolve NFC/QR payload to station metadata

404.description: Default campaign or stamp design not found

post.summary: Refresh access token using refresh cookie

parameters.name: campaignId
parameters.description: When set, returns all non-deleted designs for the campaign ordered by sortOrder

get.description: Never returns raw key or payloadToWrite.

post.description: Generates a cryptographically random key, stores only key_hash and key_prefix. Returns payloadToWrite exactly once — copy or write it to the physical tag immediately.
Parses payloadReadBack, verifies hash match, stores installation GPS/device metadata. Does not mutate station latitude/longitude.

patch.summary: Mark a scan key as lost

patch.description: Only DRAFT or INACTIVE keys can become ACTIVE. Multiple ACTIVE NFC keys per station are allowed.

get.summary: List active campaigns that include this station
List roles assigned to a user
Active reward milestones for a campaign
List active stations on an active line
Get active metro line with stations
Resolve collect outcome by idempotency key (read-only)
List stations for an active campaign
List active campaigns with stations and stamp previews

patch.description: Dense-renumbers all lines to 0..n-1. orderedIds must be a permutation of every existing line id.

400.description: INVALID_REORDER — duplicate/null orderedIds or invalid request

409.description: REORDER_CONFLICT — orderedIds do not match current scope membership

patch.description: Dense-renumbers all stations on the given line to 0..n-1. orderedIds must be a permutation of every station id on that line (all statuses).

400.description: INVALID_REORDER — duplicate/null orderedIds or invalid request

409.description: REORDER_CONFLICT — orderedIds do not match current scope membership

patch.summary: Reorder stamp designs in a campaign
patch.description: Dense-renumbers all non-deleted stamp designs in the campaign to 0..n-1. Scope is campaign-wide catalog order.

400.description: INVALID_REORDER — duplicate/null orderedIds or invalid request

409.description: REORDER_CONFLICT — orderedIds do not match current scope membership

patch.description: Dense-renumbers all non-deleted milestones in the campaign to 0..n-1.

400.description: INVALID_REORDER — duplicate/null orderedIds or invalid request

409.description: REORDER_CONFLICT — orderedIds do not match current scope membership

get.summary: List eligible partner banners for mobile Home carousel

payload.description: Raw NFC/QR key (e.g. nfc_test_home_001) or metrostamp URI (e.g. metrostamp://scan?k=nfc_test_home_001). Not stored server-side.

RuntimeCollectStampRequest.description: Stage 4 collect request — scan type + payload, GPS always required

collected.description: Distinct stations collected for the campaign

payloadToWrite.description: Full NDEF URI payload to write to the physical tag. Returned only once at creation. Mobile should write this as an NDEF URI record. Never stored or listed again.

StampBookResponse.description: Stamp book grid for a line/campaign

StampBookStationResponse.description: One cell in the stamp book grid

CollectStatusResponse.description: Read-only collect outcome for an idempotency key

bearerAuth.description: JWT Authorization header using the Bearer scheme
